WORK_RESEARCH.intent: Study complete works for hook, dialogue-response rhythm, visual hierarchy and ending.

RADAR.intent: Find traceable human-seeded anecdotes and preserve provenance.

EDITORIAL.intent: Turn source material into a distinct story-empathy experience without forcing recurring cast.

STORYBOARD.intent: Design slide roles, dialogue space, reactions and visual information ownership.

ASSET_PRODUCTION.intent: Resolve the approved production registry and author/QC/register only missing reusable or episode-local visual assets. Full-frame generation is an explicit exception lane, not the default final renderer.

COMPOSITION.intent: Build each final text-free frame deterministically from approved hash-bound asset IDs and transforms, then keep lettering, speech bubbles and messenger UI editable and separate.

QC.intent: Run hard frame/identity/geometry checks first, then sequence-level redundancy and semantic-acting review, quarantining rejected outputs and repairing only the minimum invalid scope.
